issues.on_page: Note 13 (report p42 / full PDF p44): Property Taxes for TIF Financing - Nebraska Crossing 1,978,240, Royal View 506,272, Gretna Senior Living 375,749, Batis Development 122,782 (no subtotal, fund not named); p6 TIF column 'Incentive revenue and taxes' 2,983,043, the TIF fund's only revenue (all other TIF rows '-')
issues.issue: Split is supported: the four printed note amounts sum to exactly 2,983,043, the TIF fund column, which holds nothing else; note 7D and the Statement of Activities ('TIF and incentive taxes') confirm these are incremental property taxes. The only link between note and fund is that exact dollar match, because the note prints no subtotal and doesn't name the fund. The note matches the GAAP column, not the budget-basis TIF actual of 2,978,043 (p12); that detail line (detail[48]) is now property tax by fund name, see the next issue.

issues.on_page: TIF Fund (budgetary basis) Taxes Actual 2,978,043, budget 2,620,000; the fund's only revenue line
issues.issue: Relaxed-rule check: supported under rule 2 (fund name). 'TIF' (tax increment financing) can only mean the property tax increment, and the fund has no other revenue; the GAAP column of the same fund (p6, 2,983,043) is printed in note 13 as Property Taxes for TIF Financing. The 5,000 gap between budgetary basis and modified accrual is a measurement-basis difference, not a different tax, so the rule-5 'budget-basis line that doesn't tie' exclusion doesn't defeat the fund-name rule. Amount, page, budget and computed tag are correct. Two points remain judgment calls: the fund name says 'TIF', not 'property tax', and the computed text says note 13 'prints the TIF fund's taxes', but note 13 doesn't name the fund; it ties only through the p6 column. Also, output/json/_meta/tax_splits.csv row for detail 48 still says 'not split' (stale).

Split items carry a made-up 'parent (child)' label, not the printed breakdown label the split rule asks for. The same applies to receipts[1]-[3] (Franchise, Occupation, Sales) and receipts[12]-[14] (Motor vehicle pro rate, In lieu of taxes, Homestead exemption). Amounts are correct.

The same line in detail[64] and detail[68] (p17, 'Capital facility charges and capital reimbursements') is category Utility Charges. The same label should get one category throughout the report. Either is defensible, but they don't match.

issues.on_page: Other revenues 7,669,280 (General 4,654,241 printed 'Other' on p14; Street 3,015,039, whose p11 budget schedule labels it 'Reimbursements and other revenues' 2,965,611)
issues.issue: 'other' is defensible because neither part is mostly one specific category. The Street part is partly reimbursements, and the Statement of Activities (p2) shows a 'Gain on disposal of capital assets' of 2,398,605, so part may be Sale of Property. This is already in decision_needed.
